crossRefs.note: “They say, ‘If a man puts away his wife, and she goes from him, and becomes another man’s, should he return to her…
In the ninth year of Hoshea the king of Assyria took Samaria, and carried Israel away to Assyria, and placed them in…
In the fourth year of king Hezekiah, which was the seventh year of Hoshea son of Elah king of Israel, Shalmaneser king…
“Therefore I delivered her into the hand of her lovers, into the hand of the Assyrians, on whom she doted.
Contend with your mother! Contend, for she is not my wife, neither am I her husband; and let her put away her…
Lest I strip her naked, and make her bare as in the day that she was born, and make her like a wilderness, and set her…
For the children of Israel shall live many days without king, and without prince, and without sacrifice, and without…
“Though you, Israel, play the prostitute, yet don’t let Judah offend; and don’t come to Gilgal, neither go up to Beth…
“All their wickedness is in Gilgal; for there I hated them. Because of the wickedness of their deeds I will drive them…
When a man takes a wife and marries her, then it shall be, if she finds no favor in his eyes because he has found some…
Yahweh says, “Where is the bill of your mother’s divorce, with which I have put her away? Or to which of my creditors…
Also Judah didn’t keep the commandments of Yahweh their God, but walked in the statutes of Israel which they made.
“Her sister Oholibah saw this, yet she was more corrupt in her lusting than she, and in her prostitution which was more…
“Though you, Israel, play the prostitute, yet don’t let Judah offend; and don’t come to Gilgal, neither go up to Beth…

parallels.note: They said, “Should he deal with our sister as with a prostitute?”

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: I saw when, for this very cause, that backsliding Israel had committed adultery, I had put her away and given her a certificate of divorce, yet treacherous Judah, her sister, had no fear; but she also went and played the prostitute.
translations.bsb: She saw that because faithless Israel had committed adultery, I gave her a certificate of divorce and sent her away. Yet that unfaithful sister Judah had no fear and prostituted herself as well.
translations.kjv: And I saw, when for all the causes whereby backsliding Israel committed adultery I had put her away, and given her a bill of divorce; yet her treacherous sister Judah feared not, but went and played the harlot
translations.asv: And I saw, when, for this very cause that backsliding Israel had committed adultery, I had put her away and given her a bill of divorcement, yet treacherous Judah her sister feared not; but she also went and played the harlot.
